UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_TiedAttachment: Improvised tie — wears from native head/clothing damage.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftingTieInstructio: Wear compatible glasses, a straw hat or a summer hat. Keep one supported tying material and a little free inventory space. Consumes one material use, keeps the original eyewear and equips its finite improvised tie. The matching tie slot must be free.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableInstructions: Wear in the retainer slot alongside glasses. Protects one compatible untied pair; take off to reuse. Monocles and hats are excluded.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableDurability: Native head/clothing damage can wear this retainer. Protection ends when it breaks; hidden knock-off rolls are not counted.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableProtection: Worn eyewear retainer is applying the server retention setting.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftClothRetainer: Makes one reusable cloth retainer from two ripped sheets and two uses of twine or thread. Wear with compatible glasses.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftLeatherRetainer: Makes one reusable leather retainer from two leather strips, four thread uses and two rubber bands. A sewing needle and scissors are kept.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_UnbreakableInstructio: Rare loot only: school lockers, optical-store containers and pharmacy cabinets. Cannot be crafted. Wear in the retainer slot to protect one compatible pair of glasses. Monocles and hats are excluded.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_UnbreakableCondition: Unbreakable — no wear or catch durability loss.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_ImprovisedTieInstruct: Created by Tie for specific glasses or a hat. Wear both linked items. Head/clothing damage wears native condition. Right-click the linked glasses/hat to reinforce or untie. Transfer both together. Zip ties require cutting; no material refund.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_TieActive: Linked tie is worn and securing this item.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_TieInactive: Tie inactive — wear the matching tie with this item. Legacy upgrade requires a free matching tie slot and inventory space on the server.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_LegacyTie: Legacy tie: original 10-point condition preserved. Untie and retie to use reinforcement.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_ZipCutting: Removal requires a usable sharp knife or scissors in your main inventory. Tool is kept.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_RetainerTapeInstructi: Right-click this cloth/leather retainer in your main inventory to reinforce once with adhesive or duct tape. Raises wear resistance without repairing condition.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearResistance: Wear resistance: one-in-%1 chance to lose condition on eligible head/clothing damage.
